crossRefs.note: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and…
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to…
nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus…
Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
“Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

translations.web: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
translations.bsb: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
translations.kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before
translations.asv: Behold, he will slay me; I have no hope: Nevertheless I will maintain my ways before him.
